children: faces a narrow revenue hurdle and a bigger test of what comes next. The enterprise and government AI software provider heads into its November 2 earnings report with expected revenue less than 1% above its guidance midpoint. Shares rose 0.77% to $185.53 at 9:32 a.m. ET on November 2. With that small gap, the outlook could carry more weight than a modest quarterly beat.

The Stocktwits preview published by Yahoo Finance puts expected revenue at $2.18 billion, against company guidance of $2.160 billion$2.164 billion. Palantir's August results outlined adjusted operating income of $1.292 billion$1.296 billion and full-year adjusted free cash flow of $4.5 billion$4.7 billion. Its November 2 results webcast is scheduled for 5 p.m. ET. The revenue estimate sits roughly 0.8% above the guidance midpoint, while the operating-income midpoint implies an adjusted margin near 60%.

The sharper question: can Palantir sustain that margin and lift its cash-flow outlook? Those signals could tell investors more than a small revenue surprise. The GuruFocus graphic shows a GF Score of 85/100, with momentum and growth standing out while profitability trails the other dimensions. That profile adds another reason to watch whether expanding AI adoption translates into durable earnings and cash generation.

title: Palantir Stocks Edge Higher With Earnings Facing a Narrow Revenue Expectation Gap
